notes: Hard build/toolchain task. dependent_stages=3: a single /app/Makefile must drive a full CMake configure+build of three C executables, the built /app/bin/prog must then be exposed on the shell PATH via a symlink, and a separate build.sh must produce a byte-for-byte reproducible zstd-compressed GNU tar of the tree. reasoning_depth=2: the agent must implement a correct fixed-arg-order block cipher (xor/skip modes, hex IO, exact mod-256 output) from a written contract. debugging_ambiguity=2: the cipher only passes when the C implementation matches an independent reference bit-for-bit across both modes. adversarial_inputs=3 + hidden_case_generalization=2: hidden cases exercise empty data, empty key (exit 2), non-hex input (exit 2), too-few args (exit 1), a large buffer, and swapped key/data order — the tool must neither crash nor produce a wrong stream for any of them. quantitative_correctness=3: every prog byte output and every exit code is compared exactly against an independent Python oracle. resource_pressure=1: the verifier deletes /app/bin and proves `make` rebuilds all three from source, and build.sh must be reproducible across runs; both are cheap but prove generality. Binaries are built statically so ldd reports zero external dependencies. Bucket total 18 => hard, matching the C-6b12d22b floor and the difficulty_target.
